_header.labelledBy: Claude (Sonnet 5.5, tdd-guide agent) for the Hirelane Slice 3 scam-signal lane
_header.method: Synthetic hand-written notice lines labelled scam or legit, with the expected signal ids for scam lines, written BEFORE detectScamSignals existed. Legit lines include hard negatives (negated fees, paid training, plain deadlines, official WhatsApp numbers, free-mail senders for small employers with no company domain, strong fresher pay at real firms). Free-mail cases use the real free-mail domains with obviously fictional local parts; every other address is example.test; phones are 90000 0000nn.
